spec.name: M5.PhysicalRecovery.state_domains
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (p : List Bool), 0 < N → p.length ≤ M5.PhysicalRecovery.decisionCount N → M5.PhysicalRecovery.StateOK N p
spec.guidance: Unfold selected/available wrappers and StateOK. Every selected/available positive position is i+1 with i<N-1, hence below positive N. Zero is inserted into both selected sets and cannot occur in available sets. Disjointness follows from offset+i<p.length versus p.length<=offset+i; Nat arithmetic and image membership suffice. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Preserve the exact target and original assumptions.

spec.name: M5.PhysicalRecovery.valid_words_length
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (q : List Bool), q ∈ M5.PhysicalRecovery.validWords N w F → q.length = M5.PhysicalRecovery.decisionCount N
spec.guidance: Unfold validWords and wordValid, use filter membership; this is the actual finite semantic set, not an arbitrary predicate assumption. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Preserve the exact target and original assumptions.

spec.name: M5.PhysicalRecovery.encode_decode
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (q : List Bool), 0 < N → q.length = M5.PhysicalRecovery.decisionCount N → M5.PhysicalRecovery.encode N (M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA N q) (M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB N q) = q
spec.guidance: Extensional equality of lists via length and getElem. List.ofFn has the declared length. Split each index at N-1; membership in selected positive image detects exactly whether that q index is true. Use Bool cases, image injectivity of i+1 and offset arithmetic. N=1 gives zero decision length and must remain included. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Preserve the exact target and original assumptions.

spec.name: M5.PhysicalRecovery.decode_encode
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (A B : Finset ℕ), 0 < N → A ⊆ Finset.range N → B ⊆ Finset.range N → 0 ∈ A → 0 ∈ B → (M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA N (M5.PhysicalRecovery.encode N A B) = A ∧ M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB N (M5.PhysicalRecovery.encode N A B) = B)
spec.guidance: Finset extensionality. Zero is already anchored; each positive position s<N corresponds uniquely to i=s-1 in range(N-1). List.getElem?_ofFn identifies encoded membership. Cases at the offset distinguish the two blocks. No weight, signature or injectivity assumption may be added. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Preserve the exact target and original assumptions.

spec.name: M5.PhysicalRecovery.prefix_extension
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (p q : List Bool), 0 < N → p.length ≤ M5.PhysicalRecovery.decisionCount N → q.length = M5.PhysicalRecovery.decisionCount N → (p.IsPrefix q ↔ M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA N p ⊆ M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA N q ∧ M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA N q ⊆ M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA N p ∪ M5.PhysicalRecovery.availableA N p ∧ M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB N p ⊆ M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB N q ∧ M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB N q ⊆ M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB N p ∪ M5.PhysicalRecovery.availableB N p)
spec.guidance: Characterize list prefix by equality of Boolean entries at all processed indices. True processed entries force inclusion in the selected set; false processed entries force exclusion from the full selected support since only unprocessed positions are available. Conversely the two support containments force every processed bit, with block offset N-1. Zero anchors are fixed and contain no decision bit. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Preserve the exact target and original assumptions.

spec.name: M5.PhysicalRecovery.semantic_completion_count
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), 0 < N → 0 < w → F.Monic → F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N → ∀ p : List Bool, p.length ≤ M5.PhysicalRecovery.decisionCount N → (M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA N p).card ≤ w → (M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB N p).card ≤ w → M5.PrefixPartition.count (M5.PhysicalRecovery.validWords N w F) p = (M5.PhysicalRecovery.completionSet N w F p).card
spec.guidance: Prove the actual finite-set cardinality bijection. Map a valid full word extending p to tails selectedA(q)\selectedA(p), selectedB(q)\selectedB(p). Prefix_extension yields tails contained in available sets; cardinality of difference is w-selected.card. Reverse map completion tails U,V to encode N (selectedA(p) union U) (selectedB(p) union V). StateOK plus available disjointness supplies original physical constraints; decode_encode and encode_decode prove inverse and signature/gcd preservation. Normalize Finset.product_eq_sprod before product membership. Finset.card_bij or bijective maps may be used. Do not assume this correspondence or oracle correctness. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Preserve the exact target and original assumptions.

spec.name: M5.PhysicalRecovery.overfull_prefix_zero
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (p : List Bool), 0 < N → p.length ≤ M5.PhysicalRecovery.decisionCount N → (w < (M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA N p).card ∨ w < (M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB N p).card) → M5.PrefixPartition.count (M5.PhysicalRecovery.validWords N w F) p = 0
spec.guidance: Any valid full word extending p would contain the selected prefix support by prefix_extension, but its corresponding full support has cardinality w. Finset.card_le_card contradicts an overfull selected block. Thus the filtered prefix set is empty. This discharges the original overflow zero case rather than excluding it. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Preserve the exact target and original assumptions.

spec.name: M5.PhysicalRecovery.arithmetic_oracle_exact
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), 0 < N → 0 < w → F.Monic → F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N → ∀ p : List Bool, p.length ≤ M5.PhysicalRecovery.decisionCount N → M5.PhysicalRecovery.oracle N w F p = M5.PrefixPartition.count (M5.PhysicalRecovery.validWords N w F) p
spec.guidance: Split both selected-cardinality guards. With both bounds, StateOK supplies PrefixOK and accepted ConditionalCount.exact_completion_C rewrites the actual arithmetic oracle; semantic_completion_count identifies the same cardinality. Otherwise completionC is zero by its guard and overfull_prefix_zero proves semantic zero. No correctness premise on an arbitrary oracle is allowed. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Preserve the exact target and original assumptions.

spec.name: M5.PhysicalRecovery.initial_oracle
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), 0 < N → 0 < w → F.Monic → F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N → M5.PhysicalRecovery.oracle N w F [] = M5.OrderCount.C N w F
spec.guidance: At empty prefix selected supports are singleton0 and available sets are exactly OrderCount.positivePositions N. Use accepted conditional exact count and OrderCount.exact_C to identify their tail pair sets: union singleton0 equals insert0; powerset tail sizes are w-1. For w>N both semantic sets are empty; do not add w<=N. Alternatively unfold the arithmetic sums with selected residue1 and selected supportGcd=N. This identifies actual initial arithmetic C, not an assumed initial oracle value. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Preserve the exact target and original assumptions.

spec.name: M5.PhysicalRecovery.actual_split
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), 0 < N → 0 < w → F.Monic → F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N → ∀ p : List Bool, p.length < M5.PhysicalRecovery.decisionCount N → M5.PhysicalRecovery.oracle N w F p = M5.PhysicalRecovery.oracle N w F (p ++ [false]) + M5.PhysicalRecovery.oracle N w F (p ++ [true])
spec.guidance: Apply arithmetic_oracle_exact at p and both children; their lengths are within the decision budget. Use accepted PrefixPartition.count_partition for Bool and valid_words_length, then evaluate the two-element Boolean sum. This proves split for the specific arithmetic oracle, including overfull states. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Preserve the exact target and original assumptions.

spec.name: M5.PhysicalRecovery.actual_terminal
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), 0 < N → 0 < w → F.Monic → F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N → ∀ p : List Bool, p.length = M5.PhysicalRecovery.decisionCount N → 0 < M5.PhysicalRecovery.oracle N w F p → M5.PhysicalRecovery.wordValid N w F p
spec.guidance: Use accepted PrefixPartition.count_terminal at the actual validWords set and arithmetic_oracle_exact. Positive indicator forces p membership; filter membership yields wordValid. All arithmetic and terminal correctness premises are discharged. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Preserve the exact target and original assumptions.

spec.name: M5.PhysicalRecovery.recover_actual
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), 0 < N → 0 < w → F.Monic → F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N → 0 < M5.OrderCount.C N w F → M5.PhysicalRecovery.wordValid N w F (M5.PhysicalRecovery.recoverWord N w F)
spec.guidance: Instantiate accepted BinaryRecovery.recover_valid with the concrete oracle N w F, Valid=wordValid N w F, and m=2*(N-1). Discharge split by actual_split, terminal by actual_terminal, and initial positivity by initial_oracle. recoverWord is the deterministic false-first arithmetic procedure; wordValid includes exact decision length and actual anchored supports of weightw, combined gcd1 and complete signatureF. Do not leave generic split/terminal/oracle-correctness assumptions in the result. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Preserve the exact target and original assumptions.
